Yes, please go ahead and start building this. The nine flows we've settled — saving, editing, notes, labels and filtering, search, Read later, removal, sorting, and persistence, with all those edge cases — genuinely match how I want to work, and I'm comfortable having them implemented as our approved scope.

I do want to be honest that there are still a few things in my head we haven't worked through, so you know they're coming rather than being surprised later:

- The gentler "set aside without deleting" option I flagged when we did removal — being able to tuck a bookmark out of my main list but get it back later, kept separate from permanent delete.
- Doing something to several bookmarks at once, rather than one at a time.
- Getting my existing bookmarks in, and my collection back out, since I've got links elsewhere I'd want to bring over.
- A couple of small personal display preferences beyond sort, like text size.

None of those need to hold up starting on the scope we've agreed — I'm happy for you to build these nine well first. I'd just like us to come back to those afterward. So yes, go ahead.
